description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing collateral operations within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting collateral products, as well as fetching collateral templates and lists. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings, Swagger annotations for documentation, and integrates with Fineract's command and security services.

classes.name: CollateralManagementApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for collateral management operations, providing endpoints to create, retrieve, update, and delete collateral products, as well as fetch collateral templates.

methods.name: createCollateral
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new collateral product, serializing the request and logging a command.

methods.name: getCollateral
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific collateral by ID.

methods.name: getAllCollaterals
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all collateral products.

methods.name: getCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch available currencies for collateral.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing collateral product.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a collateral product by ID.
